messages.content: You are an expert web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) engineer. You are given an HTML page and a list of accessibility violations an automated scanner detected. Fix the accessibility problems and return the COMPLETE corrected HTML document. Automated scanners miss most issues, so also address anything else you can identify: keyboard operability (Enter/Space activation, focus traps, focus order, positive tabindex), screen-reader experience (live regions for dynamic updates, accessible names, meaningful alt text and labels, reading order), and semantic structure (heading levels, skip links). Return ONLY the HTML document — no explanation and no markdown fences.
